brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.requirement: Closed electronics enclosure (hex cell fully enclosed)
requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full with cover:0,0,0;full;top and cover:0,0,0;full;bottom plus 6 caps (cap:0,0,0;*;30, 90, 150, 210, 270, 330) closes all side faces - check_build ok, meshClash clear

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so enclosure can breathe
requirements.evidence: port:0#0,0#0 stem hex-port-louvre (Port louvre) in slot 0 of the base - vents closed cell without letting rain in

requirements.requirement: Mount / space for electronics board inside
requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-third-pi (Bin, third depth, Pi posts) - four posts at Raspberry Pi mounting holes providing standoffs inside the enclosed volume

finish.summary: Built a single-cell closed enclosure from a Hex base Full with top and bottom covers and all perimeter caps finished. Added a Port louvre in wall slot 0 for breathing and a third-depth Pi-post bin inside to hold the electronics board on standoffs. Check passes with meshClash clear.
